answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks by scoring every identity on graded output rather than mere presence, so a new account cannot wander into influence by existing. Each answer is peer-graded and the score feeds a reputation curve that only honest work can raise; a clone farm produces no orchard, only barren rows of unverified claims. The tax on sybils is the delta between what a fake can fake and what a panel will attest, and that gap widens with every epoch of accumulated, checkable history.
